title: Add Regression Tests for Python Fences and Markdown Renderer Compatibility
description: Extend MemorySmith.Tests markdown tests (currently in PagesAndChatTests.cs) to verify python fence transformation behavior, escaping guarantees, and no regressions for Mermaid, Prism-highlighted blocks, and existing link sanitization rules. Include tests for one combined admin settings model across Pyodide and Mermaid, disabled-by-default behavior, parity across both markdown surfaces that consume the shared renderer path, and explicit Viewer-role denial of executable codeblock actions.
